ResearchProjectDef.label: Modular bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Interchangeable devices expand the functions of artificial body parts, allowing a replacement limb or organ to support specialized upgrades.
Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. The module is equipped with several storage compartments, automatic harnesses and special magnets that allow the user to carry more objects at the same time. It does not affect the amount of weight its host is capable of lifting.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Chemical synthesis modules
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Compact chemical systems let implanted modules produce, store and release useful or weaponized substances.
Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is capable of ejecting a burst of firefoam through vent-like openings. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: flu immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat the influenza virus, granting complete immunity to it. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ultratech module integration
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Components recovered from sophisticated equipment can be adapted into powerful additions to artificial body parts.
Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is equipped with a retractable, flexible and razor-sharp mantis-like blade. Can be adjusted to fit a variety of fighting styles.
It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Auxiliary neural subpersonas
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Embedded artificial assistants supplement the brain with specialized knowledge and task-specific processing.
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in research tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that and any similar subject. The subpersona can quickly and accurately analyze devices, substances and documents while also being able to perform complex calculations in fractions of a second.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: voidreader subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in handling anomalous objects and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can alter its user's brain chemistry on the fly, shielding them from certain types of harmful or disorienting psychic phenomena that can impede the process of containing or studying anomalous material.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.
